en: Black‑and‑white view through two tall trees across a lawn and small pond toward a circular, domed pavilion or bandstand in a landscaped park. The scene is framed by dense foliage, with a line of poplar trees behind the pavilion. There is a handwritten date or note near the top center, and faint printed text along the bottom edge that appears to identify the location, though it is not fully legible.
